location.quote: There is no describing Paris, though;

entries.change: delete this fragment (the throat-clearing 'no describing X, though' clause), leaving 'I will put off the description of it till I get home.' as its own sentence
entries.reason: voice-critic: the 'no describing X' formula is a self-referential aside that adds no fact; the deferral ('put off the description till I get home') is a real signal the letter's closing pays off and must be preserved
